# Price Calculator

A beginner Python project that calculates the final price of an order
after applying discount and tax, with automated tests using Pytest and
GitHub Actions.

## What it does
- Takes unit price, quantity, discount % and tax %
- Returns the final price rounded to 2 decimals

## Tech
- Python
- Pytest
- GitHub Actions (CI)

## How to run
```
python app.py
```

## How to run tests
```
pip install pytest
python -m pytest
```

## CI
Tests run automatically on every push using GitHub Actions.

## What I learned
- Writing Python functions
- Writing automated tests with Pytest
- Using Git and GitHub
- Setting up a CI pipeline
